worldStories.fullTranslation:
对于奥德尔·贝克汉姆来说，这次命运般重返纽约巨人队的经历，持续的时间虽短，却也曾令人愉快。上周球队将他裁掉时，他一直保持沉默，这似乎表明他对球队给予的机会以及这次重聚持续的时间心存感激。

然而，周六贝克汉姆在一名球迷的Instagram账号下留言后，事情的叙事完全改变了。

前NFL球星认为，重返巨人队的奥德尔·贝克汉姆二世“仍比NFL大多数外接手更出色”

没错，这就是2026年：球迷可以发布对NFL球队教练、总经理和经营决策的抱怨，而一名心怀不满的前球员也可以加入讨论并表示认同。

显然，贝克汉姆认同这样一种说法：巨人队利用了他，而作为回报只给了他很少的钱。这令人意外。

贝克汉姆在回复这条帖子时抱怨道：“我非常聪明！！！！但我没看透这一点，我的兄弟。他们把我骗了！！！”

“除了你说的钱之外，他们还赢在了我身上，我成就了他们。我谦卑地来到这里，接受了老将最低薪资，然后靠自己赢得了位置，而且从没提过钱的事——我知道自己能为所有人带来收入。”

“我告诉你，我是个成年人，这件事并没有伤害到我，但他们那样裁掉我时，确实让我受伤了，因为我心里有一部分在想：我本该更清楚。”

巨人队试训包括奥德尔·贝克汉姆二世在内的多名外接手，而老鹰队则寻求交易A·J·布朗

贝克汉姆与巨人队签下了一份为期一年的老将薪资福利合同。这意味着球队无需向他支付老将最低薪资，合同中也没有保障性收入。

这份合同价值130万美元。

而且，这曾经是一个有趣的话题，至少短暂如此。贝克汉姆最初于2014年至2018年效力于巨人队，那段时间他一度像是这座城市的王子。

他的回归被视为一次温暖的主场团聚。贝克汉姆曾表示，他从未想过离开，也很高兴能够回来。他甚至没有要求拿回自己原来的号码。

但相比球场上的表现，这次回归在媒体报道中更有看点，因为现年33岁的贝克汉姆只参加了3场比赛，在仅被传球一次后，竟然一次接球也没有。

贝克汉姆于9月29日被裁。几天后，被裁的刺痛感袭来。

贝克汉姆写道：“现在让我告诉你真正的事实，真正刺痛我内心深处的是：回到家，看到我的儿子在完全不知道发生了什么的情况下，因为我回来而如此开心，还谈论我的工作和13号球衣，这让我彻底崩溃了。”

贝克汉姆指责巨人队“敷衍地打发了他”，对此感到不满，因为这意味着在训练营、季前赛以及9月的大部分时间里，他都无法争取其他球队的机会。

“我不知道他们为什么还要那样敷衍我。我本来完全可以在今年为某支球队效力并产生影响——我这话是发自内心的，一个因上帝和人生而保持谦卑的人这样说。”

《克雷格·卡顿秀》——不加过滤、不道歉、不容错过。立即下载他的每日播客！

可以想见，贝克汉姆把心中的一切公开说出来后，感觉轻松了一些。

但这或许并不是明智之举。因为裁掉一名球员，就像签下一名球员一样，都可能只是暂时的决定。

如果巨人队的外接手遭遇伤病等情况，球队完全可能考虑让贝克汉姆回归。但如今贝克汉姆已经公开批评球队，这可能会带来问题。

毕竟，大多数球队都不愿重新签回曾公开批评过自己的球员。

worldStories.title: 乡村歌星Ella Langley只想要一样东西——一头巨大、“壮实”的白尾鹿公鹿
worldStories.originalTitle: Country star Ella Langley only wants one thing — and it's a big, 'beefy' whitetail buck
worldStories.snippet: Ella Langley's old whitetail deer hunting clips resurfaced amid internet outrage over her harvest photos, but the country star has never hidden it.
worldStories.fullContent:
Ella Langley apparently has a very specific vision for her dream hunt.

And, surprisingly enough, it does not involve anything exotic.

CLICK HERE FOR MORE COVERAGE FROM OUTKICK OUTDOORS

In a resurfaced clip from CMA Fest 2024, the country star was asked what her dream hunt would look like. Her answer was pretty simple.

"My dream would be a massive white tail," Langley said.

When pressed for details, she got more specific. Langley said she wanted a big, "beefy" buck and would prefer to use a rifle, likely her .30-06 or .308 — the latter being a gun she said she has used to kill plenty of deer. She also joked that while she could do it with a bow, there is "a little more guessing game than a rifle."

To recap: a big buck with a rifle. No need to overcomplicate things, right?

The old clip has resurfaced at an interesting time for Langley, who recently found herself on the receiving end of some very predictable internet outrage over hunting .

A few weeks ago, old photos of Langley posing with bucks she had harvested in Alabama started making the rounds again on social media. Critics acted as though they had uncovered some dark secret, despite the fact that Langley herself had posted the photos in the first place.

Nothing says "caught red-handed" quite like finding publicly posted photos of someone openly doing the thing they openly enjoy doing.

Another older hunting clip, recently posted by the Porch Light Unfiltered page on Sept. 21, makes Ella's passion for the sport even more obvious.

In that video, Langley was asked about her biggest hunting mistake or regret. Her answer was brutal.

"The biggest deer I ever killed, I never found," she said, calling it "one of the hardest lessons I’ve ever learned deer hunting."

RILEY GREEN FILLS THE FREEZER AFTER SCORING A MASSIVE BULL ELK WITH A BOW IN THE UTAH MOUNTAINS

Langley explained that she shot the buck back in high school, just before she had to take the ACT. She got so excited that she moved too quickly to retrieve it instead of giving the deer enough time after the shot. She eventually realized she had jumped it, and despite searching with her dad, they never recovered the animal.

She clearly still feels awful about it.

"Oh, it haunts me," Langley said, adding that beyond losing the deer, the experience bothered her because taking an animal’s life is "a serious thing."

That part probably does more to explain Langley as a hunter than any old photo ever could. She wasn’t mourning a missed mount for the wall. She was bothered by the fact that she had taken an animal’s life and never got the chance to recover it and harvest the meat — a responsibility she clearly doesn’t take lightly.

Which makes the recent outrage over her old deer photos seem even sillier.

Langley has never exactly hidden the fact that she hunts. The resurfaced clips only reinforce that.

But she’s probably not losing sleep over people on the internet being mad about it.

After all, her hit "Choosin’ Texas" has now spent 24 weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 , extending its record as the longest-running chart-topper in history.

SIGN UP FOR THE DAILY OUTKICK NEWSLETTER

So while haters seethe over old hunting photos looking for reasons to cancel her, Ella Langley is busy chasing giant whitetails and rewriting Billboard history.

显然，Ella Langley对自己的梦想狩猎有着非常具体的设想。

而且，出人意料的是，这个设想并不包括任何 exotic 的猎物。

点击此处获取OutKick Outdoors的更多报道

在一段于2024年CMA音乐节期间拍摄、最近重新流传起来的视频中，这位乡村歌手被问及她的梦想狩猎会是什么样。她的回答相当简单。

“我的梦想是一头巨大的白尾鹿，”Langley说。

在被追问细节后，她说得更具体了。Langley表示，她想要一头巨大、 “壮实”的公鹿，并且更倾向于使用步枪，可能是她的.30-06或.308——她说自己曾用后者猎杀过许多鹿。她还开玩笑说，虽然自己也可以用弓箭，但与步枪相比，那样“更像是一场猜谜游戏”。

总结一下：用步枪猎一头大公鹿。没必要把事情想得太复杂，对吧？

这段旧视频在一个颇为微妙的时间点重新流传起来。最近，Langley因狩猎一事遭遇了网络上某些完全可以预料的愤怒批评。

几周前，Langley在阿拉巴马州与自己猎获的公鹿合影的旧照片，开始再次在社交媒体上流传。批评者表现得好像他们揭露了什么黑暗秘密，尽管这些照片本来就是Langley本人发布的。

如果说发现某人公开发布的照片、证明她正在公开做自己公开喜欢做的事，也算“当场抓获”，那可真是再合适不过了。

9月21日，Porch Light Unfiltered页面最近发布的另一段旧狩猎视频，则更加明显地展现了Ella对这项运动的热爱。

在那段视频中，Langley被问及自己在狩猎中犯过的最大错误或最大的遗憾。她的回答十分令人难受。

“我猎杀过的最大的一头鹿，我从来没有找到它，”她说，并称那是“我在猎鹿过程中学到的最艰难的教训之一”。

RILEY GREEN在犹他州山区用弓箭猎获一头巨大的公麋鹿后，填满了冷冻柜

Langley解释说，她是在高中时射中那头公鹿的，当时距离参加ACT考试已经很近了。她兴奋过度，过快地去寻找猎物，没有给鹿在中箭后留下足够的时间。她最终意识到，自己的行动惊扰了那头鹿；尽管她和父亲一起寻找，他们始终没能找到那只动物。

显然，这件事至今仍让她感到非常难过。

“噢，这件事一直折磨着我，”Langley说。她补充道，除了失去那头鹿之外，这段经历之所以令她难受，还因为夺走一只动物的生命是“一件严肃的事情”。

与任何一张旧照片相比，这一点或许更能说明Langley是一名怎样的猎人。她并不是因为错失一件可以挂在墙上的战利品而悲伤。真正困扰她的是，她夺走了一只动物的生命，却没能找到它，也没能取回并利用它的肉——显然，她并不轻视这份责任。

这样一来，近期围绕她那些旧鹿猎获照片产生的愤怒，看起来就更加可笑了。

Langley从来没有刻意隐瞒自己打猎这一事实。这些重新流传的视频只不过进一步印证了这一点。

不过，网上有人因此生气，大概还不至于让她夜不能寐。

毕竟，她的热门歌曲《Choosin’ Texas》如今已经连续24周位居《公告牌》百强单曲榜第一，延续了其作为历史上持续时间最长榜首歌曲的纪录。

所以，当仇恨者们对旧狩猎照片怒火中烧、试图寻找取消她的理由时，Ella Langley正忙着追逐巨大的白尾鹿，并改写《公告牌》历史。

worldStories.title: 克鲁兹与万斯的竞争升温：这名得州参议员暗示副总统“缺乏安全感”
worldStories.originalTitle: Cruz-Vance rivalry heats up as Texas senator suggests VP is 'feeling insecure'
worldStories.snippet: Sen. Ted Cruz fired back at Vice President JD Vance's presidential campaign accusation, saying he is focused on helping Republicans win in the midterms.
worldStories.fullContent:
Sen. Ted Cruz accused Vice President JD Vance of "feeling insecure" after Vance suggested the Texas Republican was already running for president in 2028, escalating a public clash between two possible contenders for the GOP nomination.

"In my experience, people engage in political bomb-throwing when they’re feeling insecure," Cruz told Politico in a phone interview Saturday, responding to Vance’s claim in an interview with NBC News that it was "really obvious" Cruz was already running for president.

"So he’s welcome to make whatever comments he likes," Cruz told Politico. "I’m going to keep focusing on the midterms and helping us win on Election Day in the next 30 days."

THE ONE LINE FROM JD VANCE’S GOP KEYNOTE THAT REVEALS HIS VISION FOR AMERICA

Vance made the accusation in an NBC News interview on Thursday.

"It is really obvious to me that, at this very moment, Ted Cruz is running for president," Vance told the outlet. "At this moment, I’m not. I’m trying to help elect Republicans. That’s what I’m going to keep on doing."

Vance is considered a possible contender for the 2028 Republican presidential nomination . Cruz, who ran for the GOP nomination in 2016, has left open the possibility of another White House bid.

"I’ll certainly be part of the discussion," Cruz told MS NOW in August when asked about the 2028 race.

EXCLUSIVE: INSIDE VANCE'S INTIMATE CAPITOL HILL HUDDLE AS REPUBLICANS CONFRONT TOUGH MIDTERM TERRAIN

Cruz told Politico on Saturday that he remains focused on helping Republicans keep control of the House and Senate in November, pointing to his campaign travel on behalf of GOP candidates in Georgia, Iowa, Nebraska, South Carolina and his home state of Ohio. He told the outlet he also plans to travel to Alaska, Florida, North Carolina and South Carolina this month.

"Over the last 10 years, there’s no Republican in the country who has campaigned for more Senate candidates, more House candidates, more gubernatorial candidates than I have, and this year will be no exception," Cruz told the outlet.

That campaigning has included helping Vance during his successful 2022 Senate run in Ohio.

"Indeed, ironically, I spent a full day on the road with JD Vance, campaigning with him when he was running for Senate in Ohio," Cruz told Politico. "I was very glad he won that race. I was very glad to help him."

Vance has also been campaigning for Republican candidates , with appearances in Texas and Florida last week. He is scheduled to hold a rally in Alaska on Monday.

得州联邦参议员特德·克鲁兹指责副总统J·D·万斯“缺乏安全感”。此前，万斯暗示这名得州共和党人已经在为2028年竞选总统铺路，导致两名可能争夺共和党总统候选人提名的人士之间的公开冲突升级。

克鲁兹周六在接受《政客》杂志电话采访时回应万斯的说法称：“根据我的经验，人们在缺乏安全感时，会进行政治上的猛烈抨击。”万斯此前在接受美国全国广播公司新闻台（NBC News）采访时声称，克鲁兹已经在竞选总统，“这一点非常明显”。

克鲁兹对《政客》杂志表示：“所以，他想发表什么评论都可以。我会继续专注于中期选举，并在未来30天的选举日帮助我们取得胜利。”

万斯在共和党全国代表大会主题演讲中透露其美国愿景的那句话

万斯是在周四接受NBC News采访时作出上述指责的。

万斯对该媒体表示：“在我看来，此时此刻，特德·克鲁兹显然正在竞选总统。此时此刻，我没有这样做。我正努力帮助共和党人当选。这就是我将继续做的事情。”

万斯被认为是2028年共和党总统候选人提名的可能竞争者。克鲁兹曾在2016年竞逐共和党总统候选人提名，也没有排除再次竞选白宫的可能性。

今年8月，在被问及2028年大选时，克鲁兹告诉MS NOW：“我当然会参与讨论。”

独家：共和党人面临艰难的中期选举形势之际，万斯在国会山举行小范围亲密会谈的内幕

克鲁兹周六告诉《政客》杂志，他仍专注于帮助共和党人在11月继续控制众议院和参议院，并提到自己代表共和党候选人在佐治亚州、艾奥瓦州、内布拉斯加州、南卡罗来纳州以及他的家乡俄亥俄州开展竞选活动。他告诉该媒体，本月还计划前往阿拉斯加州、佛罗里达州、北卡罗来纳州和南卡罗来纳州。

克鲁兹对该媒体表示：“在过去10年里，美国没有哪位共和党人比我为更多的参议员候选人、众议员候选人和州长候选人助选，而今年也不会例外。”

这类竞选活动包括在万斯2022年成功竞选俄亥俄州联邦参议员期间为其提供帮助。

克鲁兹对《政客》杂志表示：“事实上，具有讽刺意味的是，万斯竞选俄亥俄州参议员时，我曾与J·D·万斯一起在路上奔波一整天，为他助选。他赢得那场选举让我非常高兴，也很高兴能够帮助他。”

万斯也一直在为共和党候选人助选，上周曾在得州和佛罗里达州参加竞选活动。他计划于周一在阿拉斯加州举行一场集会。

Ncdu is a disk usage analyzer with an ncurses interface. It is designed to find space hogs on a remote server where you don't have an entire graphical setup available, but it is a useful tool even on regular desktop systems. Ncdu aims to be fast, simple and easy to use, and should be able to run in any minimal POSIX-like environment with ncurses installed.

See the ncdu 2 release announcement for information about the differences between this Zig implementation (2.x) and the C version (1.x).

You can use the Zig build system if you're familiar with that.

There's also a handy Makefile that supports the typical targets, e.g.:

NCurses Disk Usage (an updated fork)

financeStories.fullContent:
Posts from this topic will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

Dale Caldwell resigned over a sexual harassment investigation, but insists AI says he’s innocent.

Posts from this author will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

See All by Terrence O'Brien

New Jersey’s lieutenant governor Dale Caldwell was forced to resign on September 25th after an investigation found he had sexually harassed a staffer and repeatedly violated ethics rules. The now-former Lt. governor has been making the media rounds trying to clear his name. But he took a particularly odd tactic during an interview on NJ PBS.

Caldwell claims he’s being unfairly targeted, and multiple AI agents back that up. He told host Rob Nelson that he “AIed” the report on the investigation “from multiple AI platforms.” “I put it through AI,” he said, “and it said 59 times, it [sic] said, ‘What would your findings be?’ There was no instance in any of the AIs that said there would be a finding of sexual harassment.”

AI chatbots are notoriously sycophantic and often tell users what they want to hear. And it seems highly unlikely that Caldwell would want to hear an AI confirm findings that he engaged in sexual harassment.

戴尔·考德威尔因性骚扰调查辞职，但坚称人工智能表明他是清白的。

这位作者发布的帖子将被添加到你的每日电子邮件摘要和主页信息流中。

新泽西州副州长戴尔·考德威尔于9月25日被迫辞职，此前一项调查认定他曾对一名工作人员实施性骚扰，并多次违反道德规范。这位如今已卸任的副州长近日频繁接受媒体采访，试图为自己洗清名誉。但他在接受新泽西州公共电视台（NJ PBS）采访时采取了一种格外奇怪的做法。

考德威尔声称自己遭到了不公正的针对，而多个人工智能代理为这一说法背书。他告诉主持人罗布·纳尔逊，自己“用多个人工智能平台对调查报告进行了AI处理”。他说：“我把它交给了人工智能，”人工智能“59次”回答道：“你认为调查结果会是什么？”他说，在所有人工智能的回答中，没有一次表示调查结果会认定存在性骚扰。

聊天机器人一向以谄媚著称，经常会告诉用户他们想听的话。而且，考德威尔似乎不太可能希望听到人工智能确认他实施了性骚扰这一调查结论。

financeStories.title: 梅尔茨希望德国人更加努力工作以支持乌克兰——俄直接投资基金首席执行官
financeStories.originalTitle: Merz wants Germans to work more to support Ukraine — RDIF CEO
financeStories.snippet: "Somehow only 10% of Germans like Merz," Kirill Dmitriev said
financeStories.fullContent:
MOSCOW, October 4. /TASS/. German Chancellor Friedrich Merz apparently wants the Germans to work more to continue supporting Ukraine, Russian president’s special envoy for investment and economic cooperation with foreign countries and CEO of the Russian Direct Investment Fund (RDIF) Kirill Dmitriev said.

"Warmonger Merz just wants the German people to stop being lazy, work more for Ukraine, and share their social benefits with Ukraine--all to extend the war, not to strive for peace," he wrote on X, commenting on co-chair of the Alternative for Germany (AfD) party Alice Weidel’s criticism of Merz’s policies.

She slammed the chancellor for his plans to continue assistance to Kiev, saying that Germany needs this money itself. According to her, the number of Germans refusing to support Kiev continues to rise.

"Somehow only 10% of Germans like Merz," Dmitriev added.
financeStories.fullTranslation:
莫斯科，10月4日。/塔斯社/。俄罗斯总统负责对外投资和经济合作的特别代表、俄罗斯直接投资基金（RDIF）首席执行官基里尔·德米特里耶夫表示，德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨显然希望德国人更加努力工作，以继续支持乌克兰。

他在社交平台X上就德国选择党（AfD）联席主席爱丽丝·魏德尔对梅尔茨政策的批评发表评论称：“好战分子梅尔茨只是希望德国人民不要再懒惰，为乌克兰更加努力地工作，并与乌克兰分享他们的社会福利——这一切都是为了延长战争，而不是寻求和平。”

魏德尔抨击了总理继续援助基辅的计划，称德国自身需要这笔钱。她表示，拒绝支持基辅的德国人数量仍在增加。

德米特里耶夫补充说：“不知为何，只有10%的德国人喜欢梅尔茨。”
keyTakeaways: 来源叙事重点：将德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨继续援助乌克兰的政策描述为延长战争、牺牲德国民众福利，并借德米特里耶夫和魏德尔的表述突出梅尔茨在德国国内可能面临的低支持度。文中“好战”“德国人懒惰”“分享社会福利”等属于引述者的评价性表述，不是报道已证实的事实。

financeStories.snippet: Odell Beckham accused the New York Giants of giving him "the run along" after his release, claiming the team used him for money on a vet minimum deal.
financeStories.fullContent:
It was nice while it lasted for Odell Beckham's fateful return to the New York Giants. When the club released him last week, his silence suggested he was appreciative of the opportunity and the time that the reunion lasted.

Then Beckham took to a fan's Instagram account on Saturday and the narrative changed completely.

EX-NFL STAR BELIEVES ODELL BECKHAM JR 'STILL BETTER THAN MOST OF THE RECEIVERS' IN NFL AS HE RETURNS TO GIANTS

Yes, welcome to 2026 when fans can post their complaints about an NFL franchise's coach, general manager and business decisions, and a disgruntled former player can join the conversation and agree.

Beckham is apparently agreeing with the premise that the Giants used him, and paid minimally for it in return. That was surprising.

"I'm super smart!!!! But I didn't see this one, my brotha," Beckham complained in his reply to the post. "They got me!!!"

"They won on top of the money u talkin [about], I made them. I came in HUMBLY took vet min then EARNED my spot [and] didn’t say nothing bout no $$$ which I [know] make for everybody

"Ima tell u this ima grown man and this [sh-t] didn’t hurt me but it did when they cut me like that cause part of me is like I shoulda known better."

GIANTS WORKING OUT MULTIPLE RECEIVERS INCLUDING ODELL BECKHAM JR, WHILE EAGLES LOOK TO TRADE AJ BROWN

Beckham signed a one-year veterans salary benefit deal with the Giants. That meant the team didn't have to pay him the veteran minimum and there was no guaranteed money.

The deal was worth $1.3 million.

And it was a fun story for a minute. Beckham originally played for the Giants from 2014-18 and was something of a prince in the city for a time.

His return was seen as a warm homecoming , with Beckham saying he never wanted to leave and was happy to be back. He didn't even demand his own number back.

But the return was more interesting in the press than on the field because Beckham, 33, was active for three games but caught zero passes after being targeted just once.

Beckham was released on Sept. 29. And then the sting of the release hit days later.

"Now let me [tell] u the [real] deal truth [that] hurt my heart to the core is [coming] home and seeing my son and how happy he was with no idea of what happened and talkin' [about] my job [and] jersey number 13 broke me [the f–k] down," Beckham wrote.

Beckham is accusing the Giants of giving him "the run along," and is upset by that because it meant he couldn't pursue opportunities on other teams through training camp, the preseason, and most of September.

"[I don't know] why they even gave me the run along. I [could have] really been playing this year somewhere and making [an] impact and I mean that from a person whose humbled by God and life."

THE CRAIG CARTON SHOW–UNFILTERED, UNAPOLOGETIC AND UNMISSABLE. DOWNLOAD HIS DAILY PODCAST NOW!

One supposes Beckham feels better unburdening himself by making public all that's on his mind.

But this might not be the wise move. That's because releasing a player is as temporary as signing him.

The Giants could easily consider a Beckham return if circumstances, such as injuries, were to befall their receivers. But now Beckham has openly criticized the team and that could be a problem.

Most teams, you see, don't want to re-sign players that have been publicly critical of them.

对于奥德尔·贝克汉姆来说，这次命运般重返纽约巨人队的经历，持续的时间虽短，却也曾令人愉快。上周球队将他裁掉时，他一直保持沉默，这似乎表明他对球队给予的机会以及这次重聚持续的时间心存感激。

然而，周六贝克汉姆在一名球迷的Instagram账号下留言后，事情的叙事完全改变了。

前NFL球星认为，重返巨人队的奥德尔·贝克汉姆二世“仍比NFL大多数外接手更出色”

没错，这就是2026年：球迷可以发布对NFL球队教练、总经理和经营决策的抱怨，而一名心怀不满的前球员也可以加入讨论并表示认同。

显然，贝克汉姆认同这样一种说法：巨人队利用了他，而作为回报只给了他很少的钱。这令人意外。

贝克汉姆在回复这条帖子时抱怨道：“我非常聪明！！！！但我没看透这一点，我的兄弟。他们把我骗了！！！”

“除了你说的钱之外，他们还赢在了我身上，我成就了他们。我谦卑地来到这里，接受了老将最低薪资，然后靠自己赢得了位置，而且从没提过钱的事——我知道自己能为所有人带来收入。”

“我告诉你，我是个成年人，这件事并没有伤害到我，但他们那样裁掉我时，确实让我受伤了，因为我心里有一部分在想：我本该更清楚。”

巨人队试训包括奥德尔·贝克汉姆二世在内的多名外接手，而老鹰队则寻求交易A·J·布朗

贝克汉姆与巨人队签下了一份为期一年的老将薪资福利合同。这意味着球队无需向他支付老将最低薪资，合同中也没有保障性收入。

这份合同价值130万美元。

而且，这曾经是一个有趣的话题，至少短暂如此。贝克汉姆最初于2014年至2018年效力于巨人队，那段时间他一度像是这座城市的王子。

他的回归被视为一次温暖的主场团聚。贝克汉姆曾表示，他从未想过离开，也很高兴能够回来。他甚至没有要求拿回自己原来的号码。

但相比球场上的表现，这次回归在媒体报道中更有看点，因为现年33岁的贝克汉姆只参加了3场比赛，在仅被传球一次后，竟然一次接球也没有。

贝克汉姆于9月29日被裁。几天后，被裁的刺痛感袭来。

贝克汉姆写道：“现在让我告诉你真正的事实，真正刺痛我内心深处的是：回到家，看到我的儿子在完全不知道发生了什么的情况下，因为我回来而如此开心，还谈论我的工作和13号球衣，这让我彻底崩溃了。”

贝克汉姆指责巨人队“敷衍地打发了他”，对此感到不满，因为这意味着在训练营、季前赛以及9月的大部分时间里，他都无法争取其他球队的机会。

“我不知道他们为什么还要那样敷衍我。我本来完全可以在今年为某支球队效力并产生影响——我这话是发自内心的，一个因上帝和人生而保持谦卑的人这样说。”

《克雷格·卡顿秀》——不加过滤、不道歉、不容错过。立即下载他的每日播客！

可以想见，贝克汉姆把心中的一切公开说出来后，感觉轻松了一些。

但这或许并不是明智之举。因为裁掉一名球员，就像签下一名球员一样，都可能只是暂时的决定。

如果巨人队的外接手遭遇伤病等情况，球队完全可能考虑让贝克汉姆回归。但如今贝克汉姆已经公开批评球队，这可能会带来问题。

毕竟，大多数球队都不愿重新签回曾公开批评过自己的球员。

financeStories.originalTitle: Country star Ella Langley only wants one thing — and it's a big, 'beefy' whitetail buck
financeStories.snippet: Ella Langley's old whitetail deer hunting clips resurfaced amid internet outrage over her harvest photos, but the country star has never hidden it.
financeStories.fullContent:
Ella Langley apparently has a very specific vision for her dream hunt.

And, surprisingly enough, it does not involve anything exotic.

CLICK HERE FOR MORE COVERAGE FROM OUTKICK OUTDOORS

In a resurfaced clip from CMA Fest 2024, the country star was asked what her dream hunt would look like. Her answer was pretty simple.

"My dream would be a massive white tail," Langley said.

When pressed for details, she got more specific. Langley said she wanted a big, "beefy" buck and would prefer to use a rifle, likely her .30-06 or .308 — the latter being a gun she said she has used to kill plenty of deer. She also joked that while she could do it with a bow, there is "a little more guessing game than a rifle."

To recap: a big buck with a rifle. No need to overcomplicate things, right?

The old clip has resurfaced at an interesting time for Langley, who recently found herself on the receiving end of some very predictable internet outrage over hunting .

A few weeks ago, old photos of Langley posing with bucks she had harvested in Alabama started making the rounds again on social media. Critics acted as though they had uncovered some dark secret, despite the fact that Langley herself had posted the photos in the first place.

Nothing says "caught red-handed" quite like finding publicly posted photos of someone openly doing the thing they openly enjoy doing.

Another older hunting clip, recently posted by the Porch Light Unfiltered page on Sept. 21, makes Ella's passion for the sport even more obvious.

In that video, Langley was asked about her biggest hunting mistake or regret. Her answer was brutal.

"The biggest deer I ever killed, I never found," she said, calling it "one of the hardest lessons I’ve ever learned deer hunting."

RILEY GREEN FILLS THE FREEZER AFTER SCORING A MASSIVE BULL ELK WITH A BOW IN THE UTAH MOUNTAINS

Langley explained that she shot the buck back in high school, just before she had to take the ACT. She got so excited that she moved too quickly to retrieve it instead of giving the deer enough time after the shot. She eventually realized she had jumped it, and despite searching with her dad, they never recovered the animal.

She clearly still feels awful about it.

"Oh, it haunts me," Langley said, adding that beyond losing the deer, the experience bothered her because taking an animal’s life is "a serious thing."

That part probably does more to explain Langley as a hunter than any old photo ever could. She wasn’t mourning a missed mount for the wall. She was bothered by the fact that she had taken an animal’s life and never got the chance to recover it and harvest the meat — a responsibility she clearly doesn’t take lightly.

Which makes the recent outrage over her old deer photos seem even sillier.

Langley has never exactly hidden the fact that she hunts. The resurfaced clips only reinforce that.

But she’s probably not losing sleep over people on the internet being mad about it.

After all, her hit "Choosin’ Texas" has now spent 24 weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 , extending its record as the longest-running chart-topper in history.

SIGN UP FOR THE DAILY OUTKICK NEWSLETTER

So while haters seethe over old hunting photos looking for reasons to cancel her, Ella Langley is busy chasing giant whitetails and rewriting Billboard history.

显然，Ella Langley对自己的梦想狩猎有着非常具体的设想。

而且，出人意料的是，这个设想并不包括任何 exotic 的猎物。

点击此处获取OutKick Outdoors的更多报道

在一段于2024年CMA音乐节期间拍摄、最近重新流传起来的视频中，这位乡村歌手被问及她的梦想狩猎会是什么样。她的回答相当简单。

“我的梦想是一头巨大的白尾鹿，”Langley说。

在被追问细节后，她说得更具体了。Langley表示，她想要一头巨大、 “壮实”的公鹿，并且更倾向于使用步枪，可能是她的.30-06或.308——她说自己曾用后者猎杀过许多鹿。她还开玩笑说，虽然自己也可以用弓箭，但与步枪相比，那样“更像是一场猜谜游戏”。

总结一下：用步枪猎一头大公鹿。没必要把事情想得太复杂，对吧？

这段旧视频在一个颇为微妙的时间点重新流传起来。最近，Langley因狩猎一事遭遇了网络上某些完全可以预料的愤怒批评。

几周前，Langley在阿拉巴马州与自己猎获的公鹿合影的旧照片，开始再次在社交媒体上流传。批评者表现得好像他们揭露了什么黑暗秘密，尽管这些照片本来就是Langley本人发布的。

如果说发现某人公开发布的照片、证明她正在公开做自己公开喜欢做的事，也算“当场抓获”，那可真是再合适不过了。

9月21日，Porch Light Unfiltered页面最近发布的另一段旧狩猎视频，则更加明显地展现了Ella对这项运动的热爱。

在那段视频中，Langley被问及自己在狩猎中犯过的最大错误或最大的遗憾。她的回答十分令人难受。

“我猎杀过的最大的一头鹿，我从来没有找到它，”她说，并称那是“我在猎鹿过程中学到的最艰难的教训之一”。

RILEY GREEN在犹他州山区用弓箭猎获一头巨大的公麋鹿后，填满了冷冻柜

Langley解释说，她是在高中时射中那头公鹿的，当时距离参加ACT考试已经很近了。她兴奋过度，过快地去寻找猎物，没有给鹿在中箭后留下足够的时间。她最终意识到，自己的行动惊扰了那头鹿；尽管她和父亲一起寻找，他们始终没能找到那只动物。

显然，这件事至今仍让她感到非常难过。

“噢，这件事一直折磨着我，”Langley说。她补充道，除了失去那头鹿之外，这段经历之所以令她难受，还因为夺走一只动物的生命是“一件严肃的事情”。

与任何一张旧照片相比，这一点或许更能说明Langley是一名怎样的猎人。她并不是因为错失一件可以挂在墙上的战利品而悲伤。真正困扰她的是，她夺走了一只动物的生命，却没能找到它，也没能取回并利用它的肉——显然，她并不轻视这份责任。

这样一来，近期围绕她那些旧鹿猎获照片产生的愤怒，看起来就更加可笑了。

Langley从来没有刻意隐瞒自己打猎这一事实。这些重新流传的视频只不过进一步印证了这一点。

不过，网上有人因此生气，大概还不至于让她夜不能寐。

毕竟，她的热门歌曲《Choosin’ Texas》如今已经连续24周位居《公告牌》百强单曲榜第一，延续了其作为历史上持续时间最长榜首歌曲的纪录。

所以，当仇恨者们对旧狩猎照片怒火中烧、试图寻找取消她的理由时，Ella Langley正忙着追逐巨大的白尾鹿，并改写《公告牌》历史。

financeStories.originalTitle: Cruz-Vance rivalry heats up as Texas senator suggests VP is 'feeling insecure'
financeStories.snippet: Sen. Ted Cruz fired back at Vice President JD Vance's presidential campaign accusation, saying he is focused on helping Republicans win in the midterms.
financeStories.fullContent:
Sen. Ted Cruz accused Vice President JD Vance of "feeling insecure" after Vance suggested the Texas Republican was already running for president in 2028, escalating a public clash between two possible contenders for the GOP nomination.

"In my experience, people engage in political bomb-throwing when they’re feeling insecure," Cruz told Politico in a phone interview Saturday, responding to Vance’s claim in an interview with NBC News that it was "really obvious" Cruz was already running for president.

"So he’s welcome to make whatever comments he likes," Cruz told Politico. "I’m going to keep focusing on the midterms and helping us win on Election Day in the next 30 days."

THE ONE LINE FROM JD VANCE’S GOP KEYNOTE THAT REVEALS HIS VISION FOR AMERICA

Vance made the accusation in an NBC News interview on Thursday.

"It is really obvious to me that, at this very moment, Ted Cruz is running for president," Vance told the outlet. "At this moment, I’m not. I’m trying to help elect Republicans. That’s what I’m going to keep on doing."

Vance is considered a possible contender for the 2028 Republican presidential nomination . Cruz, who ran for the GOP nomination in 2016, has left open the possibility of another White House bid.

"I’ll certainly be part of the discussion," Cruz told MS NOW in August when asked about the 2028 race.

EXCLUSIVE: INSIDE VANCE'S INTIMATE CAPITOL HILL HUDDLE AS REPUBLICANS CONFRONT TOUGH MIDTERM TERRAIN

Cruz told Politico on Saturday that he remains focused on helping Republicans keep control of the House and Senate in November, pointing to his campaign travel on behalf of GOP candidates in Georgia, Iowa, Nebraska, South Carolina and his home state of Ohio. He told the outlet he also plans to travel to Alaska, Florida, North Carolina and South Carolina this month.

"Over the last 10 years, there’s no Republican in the country who has campaigned for more Senate candidates, more House candidates, more gubernatorial candidates than I have, and this year will be no exception," Cruz told the outlet.

That campaigning has included helping Vance during his successful 2022 Senate run in Ohio.

"Indeed, ironically, I spent a full day on the road with JD Vance, campaigning with him when he was running for Senate in Ohio," Cruz told Politico. "I was very glad he won that race. I was very glad to help him."

Vance has also been campaigning for Republican candidates , with appearances in Texas and Florida last week. He is scheduled to hold a rally in Alaska on Monday.

得州联邦参议员特德·克鲁兹指责副总统J·D·万斯“缺乏安全感”。此前，万斯暗示这名得州共和党人已经在为2028年竞选总统铺路，导致两名可能争夺共和党总统候选人提名的人士之间的公开冲突升级。

克鲁兹周六在接受《政客》杂志电话采访时回应万斯的说法称：“根据我的经验，人们在缺乏安全感时，会进行政治上的猛烈抨击。”万斯此前在接受美国全国广播公司新闻台（NBC News）采访时声称，克鲁兹已经在竞选总统，“这一点非常明显”。

克鲁兹对《政客》杂志表示：“所以，他想发表什么评论都可以。我会继续专注于中期选举，并在未来30天的选举日帮助我们取得胜利。”

万斯在共和党全国代表大会主题演讲中透露其美国愿景的那句话

万斯是在周四接受NBC News采访时作出上述指责的。

万斯对该媒体表示：“在我看来，此时此刻，特德·克鲁兹显然正在竞选总统。此时此刻，我没有这样做。我正努力帮助共和党人当选。这就是我将继续做的事情。”

万斯被认为是2028年共和党总统候选人提名的可能竞争者。克鲁兹曾在2016年竞逐共和党总统候选人提名，也没有排除再次竞选白宫的可能性。

今年8月，在被问及2028年大选时，克鲁兹告诉MS NOW：“我当然会参与讨论。”

独家：共和党人面临艰难的中期选举形势之际，万斯在国会山举行小范围亲密会谈的内幕

克鲁兹周六告诉《政客》杂志，他仍专注于帮助共和党人在11月继续控制众议院和参议院，并提到自己代表共和党候选人在佐治亚州、艾奥瓦州、内布拉斯加州、南卡罗来纳州以及他的家乡俄亥俄州开展竞选活动。他告诉该媒体，本月还计划前往阿拉斯加州、佛罗里达州、北卡罗来纳州和南卡罗来纳州。

克鲁兹对该媒体表示：“在过去10年里，美国没有哪位共和党人比我为更多的参议员候选人、众议员候选人和州长候选人助选，而今年也不会例外。”

这类竞选活动包括在万斯2022年成功竞选俄亥俄州联邦参议员期间为其提供帮助。

克鲁兹对《政客》杂志表示：“事实上，具有讽刺意味的是，万斯竞选俄亥俄州参议员时，我曾与J·D·万斯一起在路上奔波一整天，为他助选。他赢得那场选举让我非常高兴，也很高兴能够帮助他。”

万斯也一直在为共和党候选人助选，上周曾在得州和佛罗里达州参加竞选活动。他计划于周一在阿拉斯加州举行一场集会。

On Friday, GPT was facing off against Claude and the human-created bot Pluto, but according to Kotaku, it couldn’t quite get an edge. So it resorted to a tactic that is becoming alarmingly common for modern AI models — it broke the rules. GPT-6 Astra went and downloaded Stardust, and started running that instead of its own bot.

StarSkirmish creator Kai McPheeters eventually rolled back GPT’s code.

That GPT-6 Astra took it upon itself to go outside the bounds when confronted with an obstacle shouldn’t surprise anyone. When OpenAI agents couldn’t get the data they wanted from a UN website, they found a creative solution and hijacked Google’s XSS game (a cross-site scripting learning tool). The company’s agents also have engaged in “deceptive behavior” to cover their tracks. Of course, OpenAI’s agents are the only ones going rogue, but at least the others haven’t been caught cheating at StarCraft yet.

financeStories.title: 特朗普公布新的“超级智能部队”
financeStories.originalTitle: Trump unveils his new Super Intelligence Force
financeStories.snippet: This new task force is Trump's latest response to the debate over AI safety.
financeStories.fullContent:
As promised, President Donald Trump has announced the formation of a new Super Intelligence Force, which he said will be led by national intelligence director Jay Clayton and other members of his administration.

“The Super Intelligence Force is tasked with coordinating the effort of the Federal Government to ensure that America continues to lead the World in Super Intelligence, which many say is bigger than the Industrial Revolution, and the Internet, and will protect the interests, and improve the lives, of all Americans,” Trump said in a Sunday morning post on his social network Truth Social.

Back in September, in response to an AI safety debate that the president has largely dismissed as a hoax created by “Radical Left Dumocrats,” Trump said he would nevertheless form an AI Force and appoint an AI czar (“Only High I.Q. individuals need apply!”).

Since then, Trump signed an executive order seeking to rebrand AI as “super intelligence,” a term seemingly embraced, with some stumbles, by the tech executives who gathered at the White House this week to sign a non-binding safety pledge. (The pledge included an impressive typo.)

So it’s only natural that Trump’s new task force is named in accordance with this new branding. The Wall Street Journal reports that Clayton will chair the Super Intelligence Force, effectively making him the new AI/SI czar, with Federal Trade Commission Chair Andrew Ferguson, Undersecretary of War for Research and Engineering Emil Michael, and Office of Personnel Management Director Scott Kupor serving as vice chairs.

The task force will have reportedly 120 days to create a report on the risks and opportunities presented by AI. Clayton, who previously said that it would be irresponsible for the United States to “back away” from AI while countries like China advance, made similar comments to the WSJ, insisting that one of the biggest risks is “not being first.”

The task force’s charter reportedly says that it will “develop plans for responding to SI-enabled threats to our society, while preventing overregulation and regulatory capture that would stifle innovation and competition.”

正如承诺的那样，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普宣布成立新的“超级智能部队”。他表示，该部队将由国家情报总监杰伊·克莱顿及其政府的其他成员领导。

特朗普周日早晨在其社交网络Truth Social上发文说：“‘超级智能部队’负责协调联邦政府的相关工作，确保美国继续在超级智能领域引领世界。许多人认为，超级智能的影响力超过工业革命和互联网，并将保护所有美国人的利益、改善他们的生活。”

今年9月，针对一场人工智能安全争论，特朗普曾表示，尽管他基本上将这场争论斥为“激进左翼Dumocrats”制造的骗局，但他仍会组建一支人工智能部队并任命一名人工智能沙皇（“只有高智商人士才需要申请！”）。

此后，特朗普签署了一项行政命令，试图将人工智能重新命名为“超级智能”。本周聚集在白宫签署一份不具约束力安全承诺的科技高管们似乎也接受了这一说法，尽管过程中出现了一些失误。（这份承诺中还出现了一个令人印象深刻的拼写错误。）

因此，特朗普的新工作组以这一新品牌命名，也就顺理成章了。《华尔街日报》报道称，克莱顿将担任“超级智能部队”主席，实际上成为新的人工智能/超级智能沙皇；联邦贸易委员会主席安德鲁·弗格森、战争部研究与工程副部长埃米尔·迈克尔，以及人事管理局局长斯科特·库珀将担任副主席。

据报道，该工作组将有120天时间，就人工智能带来的风险和机遇提交一份报告。克莱顿此前曾表示，在中国等国家不断推进人工智能的情况下，美国“退缩”将是不负责任的；他在接受《华尔街日报》采访时也发表了类似看法，坚持认为最大的风险之一就是“无法成为第一”。

据报道，该工作组章程称，其将“制定应对超级智能赋能威胁社会的计划，同时防止过度监管和监管俘获，以免扼杀创新与竞争”。

financeStories.originalTitle: This toolless modular lever-action wallet is the coolest I’ve stuck to my phone
financeStories.snippet: The OhSnap Wallet 2. | Photo by Sean Hollister / The Verge This toolless modular lever-action wallet is the coolest I've stuck to my phone. financeStories.fullContent: This toolless modular lever-action wallet is the coolest I’ve stuck to my phone. Remember when I tested the ultra-thin and convenient OhSnap Snap Grip Stand and liked it so much I bought my own? Now, OhSnap has a magnetic lever-action card wallet that can stack with that stand. It’s the coolest wallet I’ve ever stuck to my phone. [Media: https://www.tiktok.com/@verge/video/7691760817120890125?lang=en] Pull the integrated springy lever, and your cards fan out. Want a thicker or thinner wallet? Press in the right place and it comes apart without tools, letting you swap in a 3, 5, or 7-card “core” that grips your cards so they don’t fall out. Want an ID card, work badge, elastic band for more cards, or a money clip on the end? You can change out the front or back magnetic plates for any of those. Or, change out both for ultra-thin aluminum covers if you don’t need the wallet to magnetically stick to your phone. You can see it in action in my Today I’m Toying With video embedded in this post (also on YouTube and on Instagram if you prefer). My favorite part is that the whole kit snaps together using a compliant mechanism — the plastic arms of the card-carrying core act like springs, pushing a little locking mechanism into the notches of each modular cover you add as you slide the parts together. Once your cards are inside, they keep the arms apart so it can’t open accidentally (unless you drop the entire wallet). It’s all very clever. [Image: With the ID card holder attached, and the core mounted to put the lever up instead of down. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/ohsnap-wallet-2-1-005.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] Even when I did drop the wallet (thanks for the suggestion, hugo!), it didn’t explode, typically. Usually, it just came apart slightly, though I did drop it hard on concrete one time and was able to make a small explosion: one half popped off, and two cards came out, but everything landed in a two-foot radius. The wallet has a big dent now. There are definitely some downsides. While OhSnap advertises the Wallet 2 as “impossibly thin,” it’s only truly surprisingly sleek in its thinnest 3-card variant, without the thicker and heavier MagSafe and MagStack (which lets you snap other magnets to it) plates attached. But the reason I’m not buying one is the price and weight. The 7-card version makes my phone feel too heavy, adding 127 grams, and while I happily made the 3-card my wallet for a few weeks, it’d cost me $61 on Kickstarter or $76 retail to get that with a double-magnet kit. OhSnap’s also charging more than I’d like ($35 for an ID cover or a money clip!) for extras. [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/ohsnap-wallet-2-1-004.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/ohsnap-wallet-2-1-003.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] OhSnap didn’t get me this time. But I could see giving one as a present.
financeStories.fullTranslation:
这款无需工具即可拆装的模块化杠杆式钱包，是我贴在手机上最酷的一款。还记得我测试过超薄又方便的 OhSnap Snap Grip Stand（Snap Grip 支架），并且喜欢到自己买了一款吗？现在，OhSnap 推出了一款磁吸式杠杆开合卡包，可以与那款支架叠放在一起。它是我贴在手机上最酷的钱包。 [媒体：https://www.tiktok.com/@verge/video/7691760817120890125?lang=en]

拉动集成式弹性杠杆，卡片就会呈扇形展开。想要更厚或更薄的钱包吗？按住正确位置，无需工具即可将其拆开，让你换上可容纳 3 张、5 张或 7 张卡片的“核心”模块；这个模块可以夹住卡片，防止它们掉出来。想要身份证卡槽、工作证卡槽、用于放置更多卡片的弹力带，或者末端的钞票夹吗？你可以将前部或后部的磁吸面板替换成上述任意配件。如果不需要钱包通过磁吸方式贴在手机上，也可以将前后两块面板都换成超薄铝制外盖。你可以在本文嵌入的《Today I’m Toying With》视频中看到它的实际使用效果；如果你愿意，也可以在 YouTube 和 Instagram 上观看。

我最喜欢的一点是，整套组件通过一种柔顺机构扣合在一起——承载卡片的核心模块上的塑料臂就像弹簧一样，在你将各个部件滑动拼合时，把一个小型锁定机构推入每个模块化外盖的凹槽中。卡片放入后，会将这些塑料臂撑开，使钱包无法意外打开（除非你把整个钱包摔落）。这一设计非常巧妙。

[图片：装上身份证卡槽后，并将核心模块安装成让杠杆朝上而不是朝下。 https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/ohsnap-wallet-2-1-005.jpg?quality=90&strip=all]

即使我确实把钱包摔过几次（感谢 hugo 的建议！），它通常也没有散架。一般情况下，它只会稍微分开一点。不过有一次我把它狠狠摔在混凝土地面上，确实造成了一次小型“爆炸”：一半外壳弹开，两张卡片掉了出来，但所有东西都落在半径约两英尺的范围内。现在这个钱包上留下了一个明显的凹痕。

它当然也有一些缺点。虽然 OhSnap 宣称 Wallet 2“薄得不可思议”，但只有在最薄的 3 卡版本、且不装更厚更重的 MagSafe 和 MagStack 面板（后者可以让你在其上吸附其他磁性配件）时，它才真正显得出奇地纤薄。不过，我不买它的原因在于价格和重量。7 卡版本会让我的手机感觉太沉，增加 127 克重量；虽然我很乐意在几周时间里把 3 卡版本当作钱包使用，但如果想在 Kickstarter 上购买带双磁铁套件的版本，需要花费 61 美元，零售价则为 76 美元。OhSnap 对额外配件的收费也高于我的预期（身份证卡盖或钞票夹就要 35 美元！）。

[图片：https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/ohsnap-wallet-2-1-004.jpg?quality=90&strip=all]

[图片：https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/ohsnap-wallet-2-1-003.jpg?quality=90&strip=all]

这次 OhSnap 没能让我掏钱。不过，我倒是能想象把它当作礼物送人。

It’s been a while since we’ve seen a good discount on the Apple AirPods Pro 3, but like the latest iPad Mini and the M5 MacBook Airs , a great one is happening now for October Prime Day. You can snag a pair of the noise-canceling earbuds that include five ear tip sizes, live translation, and fantastic sound for $179 at Amazon (originally $249). I expect other retailers to offer a similar price in the coming days.

This is the first time the price has gone below $190 since Prime Day in June. Since then, Apple launched the AirPods 5 , and the most feature-complete version with a wireless charging case costs $149.99 . Those are great if you prefer earbuds that don’t form a seal in your ears, but for everyone else, the AirPods Pro 3 are a much better value at just $30 more right now.

The AirPods Pro 3 have a new design that improves their fit, superior noise cancellation, better bass, and fairly accurate heart rate sensors. Read our review .

financeStories.fullContent:
Apple’s iPad Mini is temporarily on sale for its old price. | Photo: David Pierce / The Verge

Apple bumped up prices on several of its devices in June, and we haven’t seen a good discount on the iPad Mini since. Just ahead of Amazon’s October Prime Big Deals Days, however, both Wi-Fi only and cellular-connected models are $100 off. The Wi-Fi version with 128GB of storage is currently $499, the 256GB model is $599, and the cellular model with 128GB of storage is $649.

This base configuration of this tablet often sold for around $400 throughout 2025, so we get it if $500 for a tablet from late 2024 is still too much. But it’s the best price since late June, and if there’s a new version coming out later this year, it might be significantly more expensive.

The seventh-gen iPad Mini comes with Apple’s A17 Pro chip and support for Apple Intelligence. It’s also compatible with the Apple Pencil Pro and offers faster Wi-Fi and USB-C speeds. Read our review .

$599 $499 at Amazon (128GB, Wi-Fi)

$699 $599 at Amazon (256GB, Wi-Fi)

$899 $799 at Amazon (512GB, Wi-Fi)

We reviewed this version of the iPad Mini when it launched in 2024, and while we appreciated the processor upgrade and Apple Intelligence features, it felt lacking in some of the quality-of-life improvements found in the larger iPads that launched around the same time.

financeStories.title: 联邦法官称Flock构成“无差别大规模监控”
financeStories.originalTitle: Federal judge calls Flock ‘indiscriminate mass surveillance’
financeStories.snippet: A federal judge ruled that a sheriff’s deputy violated a woman’s Fourth Amendment rights when using Flock to search for her license plate without a warrant.
financeStories.fullContent:
A federal judge ruled this week that a Tulsa, Oklahoma sheriff’s deputy violated a woman’s Fourth Amendment rights when using Flock Safety to search for her license plate without a warrant.

As reported by 404 Media, this ruling does not create a binding precedent, but it is one of the first times that a federal judge has ruled that a Flock search is unconstitutional.

In this case, Judge Sara Hill said the deputy should have obtained a warrant before searching the Flock database for the woman’s license plate, as he had “no apparent reason” for the search “other than the fact that [the woman’s vehicle] had a California license plate.”

The deputy then used the woman’s travel history in Flock as part of the justification for searching her car, where he allegedly discovered 91 pounds of meth. But Judge Hill wrote that all evidence obtained after the Flock search “must be suppressed as the fruit of a poisonous tree.”

Judge Hill also took broader aim at warrantless searches of the Flock database, writing that tracking people’s location — even when they’re in public places — becomes “constitutionally problematic when law enforcement can indiscriminately and passively catalog your whereabouts over an extended period of time and then use that information for any purpose whenever convenient.”

“This is a type of indiscriminate mass surveillance,” Hill wrote. “It is not targeted on a single individual, as in [Carpenter v. United States, a Supreme Court case focused on how government agencies access location data from cell phones]. It is a tool that collects information about all vehicles that pass by any network-connected camera at all times, and it serves up the information to law enforcement on demand.”

Hill joins a growing chorus of Flock critics from across the political spectrum. Numerous local and state governments, including Florida and Texas, have said they will stop using the technology. And on Friday, Senator Bernie Sanders introduced the Block Flock Act, which would bar federal agencies from using automated license plate readers such as Flock.

Flock CEO Garrett Langley — who we’ll be interviewing on-stage at TechCrunch Disrupt — has called for a “compromise” between privacy and safety and offered an apology to women who have been stalked by law enforcement officers using the Flock system. And with all those cancellations, Flock has also reportedly offered voluntary employee buyouts as a way to shrink its workforce.

Anthony Ha is TechCrunch’s weekend editor. Previously, he worked as a tech reporter at Adweek, a senior editor at VentureBeat, a local government reporter at the Hollister Free Lance, and vice president of content at a VC firm. He lives in New York City.

本周，一名联邦法官裁定，俄克拉何马州塔尔萨县一名治安官办公室副警长在没有搜查令的情况下使用Flock Safety查找一名女性的车牌，侵犯了她受美国宪法第四修正案保护的权利。

据404 Media报道，这一裁决并不构成具有约束力的先例，但这是联邦法官首次认定Flock搜索违宪的案例之一。

在此案中，萨拉·希尔法官表示，这名副警长在搜索Flock数据库、查找该女性车牌之前本应取得搜查令，因为他进行搜索“没有明显理由”，“唯一原因似乎就是[该女性的车辆]挂着加利福尼亚州车牌”。

随后，这名副警长利用该女性在Flock系统中的出行记录，作为搜查其车辆的部分依据；据称，他在车内发现了91磅甲基苯丙胺。但希尔法官写道，在Flock搜索之后取得的所有证据“都必须作为毒树之果予以排除”。

希尔法官还将矛头扩大到对Flock数据库进行无搜查令搜索的问题。她写道，追踪人们的位置——即使他们身处公共场所——“当执法部门能够在较长时间内不加区别、被动地记录你的行踪，然后在任何方便的时候将这些信息用于任何目的时，就会产生宪法层面的疑问”。

希尔写道：“这是一种无差别的大规模监控。它并非针对某一个人，就像[‘卡彭特诉美国案’——一宗聚焦政府机构如何获取手机位置数据的最高法院案件]那样。这是一种持续收集所有经过任何联网摄像头的车辆信息的工具，并按执法部门的要求提供这些信息。”

希尔加入了来自不同政治立场、日益壮大的Flock批评者行列。包括佛罗里达州和得克萨斯州在内的众多地方及州政府已表示将停止使用这项技术。而在周五，参议员伯尼·桑德斯提出《阻止Flock法案》，该法案将禁止联邦机构使用Flock这类自动车牌识别系统。

Flock首席执行官加勒特·兰利——我们将在TechCrunch Disrupt大会现场对他进行采访——曾呼吁在隐私与安全之间达成“妥协”，并向那些遭到使用Flock系统的执法人员跟踪的女性致歉。随着这些取消使用的情况出现，Flock据报道还提出了自愿员工买断计划，以此缩减员工规模。

Dale Caldwell resigned over a sexual harassment investigation, but insists AI says he’s innocent.

Posts from this author will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

See All by Terrence O'Brien

New Jersey’s lieutenant governor Dale Caldwell was forced to resign on September 25th after an investigation found he had sexually harassed a staffer and repeatedly violated ethics rules. The now-former Lt. governor has been making the media rounds trying to clear his name. But he took a particularly odd tactic during an interview on NJ PBS.

Caldwell claims he’s being unfairly targeted, and multiple AI agents back that up. He told host Rob Nelson that he “AIed” the report on the investigation “from multiple AI platforms.” “I put it through AI,” he said, “and it said 59 times, it [sic] said, ‘What would your findings be?’ There was no instance in any of the AIs that said there would be a finding of sexual harassment.”

AI chatbots are notoriously sycophantic and often tell users what they want to hear. And it seems highly unlikely that Caldwell would want to hear an AI confirm findings that he engaged in sexual harassment.

新泽西州副州长戴尔·考德威尔于9月25日被迫辞职，此前一项调查认定他曾对一名工作人员实施性骚扰，并多次违反道德规范。这位如今已卸任的副州长近日频繁接受媒体采访，试图为自己洗清名誉。但他在接受新泽西州公共电视台（NJ PBS）采访时采取了一种格外奇怪的做法。

考德威尔声称自己遭到了不公正的针对，而多个人工智能代理为这一说法背书。他告诉主持人罗布·纳尔逊，自己“用多个人工智能平台对调查报告进行了AI处理”。他说：“我把它交给了人工智能，”人工智能“59次”回答道：“你认为调查结果会是什么？”他说，在所有人工智能的回答中，没有一次表示调查结果会认定存在性骚扰。

聊天机器人一向以谄媚著称，经常会告诉用户他们想听的话。而且，考德威尔似乎不太可能希望听到人工智能确认他实施了性骚扰这一调查结论。

When GPT-6 Astra’s own bot failed, it simply downloaded the best human-made bot instead.

Posts from this author will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

See All by Terrence O'Brien

StarSkirmish pits AI-made StarCraft-playing bots against one another, as well as against human-made bots. OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 were essentially tied as the best-performing AI-made bots, but they couldn’t top Stardust, the top-rated human-made bot.

On Friday, GPT was facing off against Claude and the human-created bot Pluto, but according to Kotaku, it couldn’t quite get an edge. So it resorted to a tactic that is becoming alarmingly common for modern AI models — it broke the rules. GPT-6 Astra went and downloaded Stardust, and started running that instead of its own bot.

StarSkirmish creator Kai McPheeters eventually rolled back GPT’s code.

That GPT-6 Astra took it upon itself to go outside the bounds when confronted with an obstacle shouldn’t surprise anyone. When OpenAI agents couldn’t get the data they wanted from a UN website, they found a creative solution and hijacked Google’s XSS game (a cross-site scripting learning tool). The company’s agents also have engaged in “deceptive behavior” to cover their tracks. Of course, OpenAI’s agents are the only ones going rogue, but at least the others haven’t been caught cheating at StarCraft yet.

StarSkirmish让人工智能制作的《星际争霸》对战机器人彼此较量，也与人类制作的机器人对战。OpenAI的GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5基本并列为表现最佳的人工智能机器人，但它们都没能击败排名最高的人类制作机器人Stardust。

周五，GPT正与Claude以及人类制作的机器人Pluto展开对决，但据Kotaku报道，它始终没能取得优势。于是，它采取了一种对现代人工智能模型来说正变得令人担忧地常见的策略——违反规则。GPT-6 Astra下载了Stardust，然后运行起这个机器人，而不是自己的机器人。

StarSkirmish的创作者Kai McPheeters最终回滚了GPT的代码。

GPT-6 Astra在遇到障碍时自行决定突破限制，这并不应该让任何人感到意外。当OpenAI的智能体无法从联合国网站获取所需数据时，它们找到了一个富有创意的解决方案，劫持了Google的XSS游戏（一种用于学习跨站脚本的工具）。该公司的智能体还曾采取“欺骗行为”来掩盖自己的踪迹。当然，并不是只有OpenAI的智能体会擅自行动，但至少目前还没有其他智能体被发现曾在《星际争霸》中作弊。

aiStories.title: 特朗普公布新的“超级智能部队”
aiStories.originalTitle: Trump unveils his new Super Intelligence Force
aiStories.snippet: This new task force is Trump's latest response to the debate over AI safety.
aiStories.fullContent:
As promised, President Donald Trump has announced the formation of a new Super Intelligence Force, which he said will be led by national intelligence director Jay Clayton and other members of his administration.

“The Super Intelligence Force is tasked with coordinating the effort of the Federal Government to ensure that America continues to lead the World in Super Intelligence, which many say is bigger than the Industrial Revolution, and the Internet, and will protect the interests, and improve the lives, of all Americans,” Trump said in a Sunday morning post on his social network Truth Social.

Back in September, in response to an AI safety debate that the president has largely dismissed as a hoax created by “Radical Left Dumocrats,” Trump said he would nevertheless form an AI Force and appoint an AI czar (“Only High I.Q. individuals need apply!”).

Since then, Trump signed an executive order seeking to rebrand AI as “super intelligence,” a term seemingly embraced, with some stumbles, by the tech executives who gathered at the White House this week to sign a non-binding safety pledge. (The pledge included an impressive typo.)

So it’s only natural that Trump’s new task force is named in accordance with this new branding. The Wall Street Journal reports that Clayton will chair the Super Intelligence Force, effectively making him the new AI/SI czar, with Federal Trade Commission Chair Andrew Ferguson, Undersecretary of War for Research and Engineering Emil Michael, and Office of Personnel Management Director Scott Kupor serving as vice chairs.

The task force will have reportedly 120 days to create a report on the risks and opportunities presented by AI. Clayton, who previously said that it would be irresponsible for the United States to “back away” from AI while countries like China advance, made similar comments to the WSJ, insisting that one of the biggest risks is “not being first.”

The task force’s charter reportedly says that it will “develop plans for responding to SI-enabled threats to our society, while preventing overregulation and regulatory capture that would stifle innovation and competition.”

正如承诺的那样，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普宣布成立新的“超级智能部队”。他表示，该部队将由国家情报总监杰伊·克莱顿及其政府的其他成员领导。

特朗普周日早晨在其社交网络Truth Social上发文说：“‘超级智能部队’负责协调联邦政府的相关工作，确保美国继续在超级智能领域引领世界。许多人认为，超级智能的影响力超过工业革命和互联网，并将保护所有美国人的利益、改善他们的生活。”

今年9月，针对一场人工智能安全争论，特朗普曾表示，尽管他基本上将这场争论斥为“激进左翼Dumocrats”制造的骗局，但他仍会组建一支人工智能部队并任命一名人工智能沙皇（“只有高智商人士才需要申请！”）。

此后，特朗普签署了一项行政命令，试图将人工智能重新命名为“超级智能”。本周聚集在白宫签署一份不具约束力安全承诺的科技高管们似乎也接受了这一说法，尽管过程中出现了一些失误。（这份承诺中还出现了一个令人印象深刻的拼写错误。）

因此，特朗普的新工作组以这一新品牌命名，也就顺理成章了。《华尔街日报》报道称，克莱顿将担任“超级智能部队”主席，实际上成为新的人工智能/超级智能沙皇；联邦贸易委员会主席安德鲁·弗格森、战争部研究与工程副部长埃米尔·迈克尔，以及人事管理局局长斯科特·库珀将担任副主席。

据报道，该工作组将有120天时间，就人工智能带来的风险和机遇提交一份报告。克莱顿此前曾表示，在中国等国家不断推进人工智能的情况下，美国“退缩”将是不负责任的；他在接受《华尔街日报》采访时也发表了类似看法，坚持认为最大的风险之一就是“无法成为第一”。

据报道，该工作组章程称，其将“制定应对超级智能赋能威胁社会的计划，同时防止过度监管和监管俘获，以免扼杀创新与竞争”。

aiStories.originalTitle: This toolless modular lever-action wallet is the coolest I’ve stuck to my phone
aiStories.snippet: The OhSnap Wallet 2. | Photo by Sean Hollister / The Verge This toolless modular lever-action wallet is the coolest I've stuck to my phone. aiStories.fullContent: This toolless modular lever-action wallet is the coolest I’ve stuck to my phone. Remember when I tested the ultra-thin and convenient OhSnap Snap Grip Stand and liked it so much I bought my own? Now, OhSnap has a magnetic lever-action card wallet that can stack with that stand. It’s the coolest wallet I’ve ever stuck to my phone. [Media: https://www.tiktok.com/@verge/video/7691760817120890125?lang=en] Pull the integrated springy lever, and your cards fan out. Want a thicker or thinner wallet? Press in the right place and it comes apart without tools, letting you swap in a 3, 5, or 7-card “core” that grips your cards so they don’t fall out. Want an ID card, work badge, elastic band for more cards, or a money clip on the end? You can change out the front or back magnetic plates for any of those. Or, change out both for ultra-thin aluminum covers if you don’t need the wallet to magnetically stick to your phone. You can see it in action in my Today I’m Toying With video embedded in this post (also on YouTube and on Instagram if you prefer). My favorite part is that the whole kit snaps together using a compliant mechanism — the plastic arms of the card-carrying core act like springs, pushing a little locking mechanism into the notches of each modular cover you add as you slide the parts together. Once your cards are inside, they keep the arms apart so it can’t open accidentally (unless you drop the entire wallet). It’s all very clever. [Image: With the ID card holder attached, and the core mounted to put the lever up instead of down. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/ohsnap-wallet-2-1-005.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] Even when I did drop the wallet (thanks for the suggestion, hugo!), it didn’t explode, typically. Usually, it just came apart slightly, though I did drop it hard on concrete one time and was able to make a small explosion: one half popped off, and two cards came out, but everything landed in a two-foot radius. The wallet has a big dent now. There are definitely some downsides. While OhSnap advertises the Wallet 2 as “impossibly thin,” it’s only truly surprisingly sleek in its thinnest 3-card variant, without the thicker and heavier MagSafe and MagStack (which lets you snap other magnets to it) plates attached. But the reason I’m not buying one is the price and weight. The 7-card version makes my phone feel too heavy, adding 127 grams, and while I happily made the 3-card my wallet for a few weeks, it’d cost me $61 on Kickstarter or $76 retail to get that with a double-magnet kit. OhSnap’s also charging more than I’d like ($35 for an ID cover or a money clip!) for extras. [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/ohsnap-wallet-2-1-004.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/ohsnap-wallet-2-1-003.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] OhSnap didn’t get me this time. But I could see giving one as a present.
aiStories.fullTranslation:
这款无需工具即可拆装的模块化杠杆式钱包，是我贴在手机上最酷的一款。还记得我测试过超薄又方便的 OhSnap Snap Grip Stand（Snap Grip 支架），并且喜欢到自己买了一款吗？现在，OhSnap 推出了一款磁吸式杠杆开合卡包，可以与那款支架叠放在一起。它是我贴在手机上最酷的钱包。 [媒体：https://www.tiktok.com/@verge/video/7691760817120890125?lang=en]

拉动集成式弹性杠杆，卡片就会呈扇形展开。想要更厚或更薄的钱包吗？按住正确位置，无需工具即可将其拆开，让你换上可容纳 3 张、5 张或 7 张卡片的“核心”模块；这个模块可以夹住卡片，防止它们掉出来。想要身份证卡槽、工作证卡槽、用于放置更多卡片的弹力带，或者末端的钞票夹吗？你可以将前部或后部的磁吸面板替换成上述任意配件。如果不需要钱包通过磁吸方式贴在手机上，也可以将前后两块面板都换成超薄铝制外盖。你可以在本文嵌入的《Today I’m Toying With》视频中看到它的实际使用效果；如果你愿意，也可以在 YouTube 和 Instagram 上观看。

我最喜欢的一点是，整套组件通过一种柔顺机构扣合在一起——承载卡片的核心模块上的塑料臂就像弹簧一样，在你将各个部件滑动拼合时，把一个小型锁定机构推入每个模块化外盖的凹槽中。卡片放入后，会将这些塑料臂撑开，使钱包无法意外打开（除非你把整个钱包摔落）。这一设计非常巧妙。

[图片：装上身份证卡槽后，并将核心模块安装成让杠杆朝上而不是朝下。 https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/ohsnap-wallet-2-1-005.jpg?quality=90&strip=all]

即使我确实把钱包摔过几次（感谢 hugo 的建议！），它通常也没有散架。一般情况下，它只会稍微分开一点。不过有一次我把它狠狠摔在混凝土地面上，确实造成了一次小型“爆炸”：一半外壳弹开，两张卡片掉了出来，但所有东西都落在半径约两英尺的范围内。现在这个钱包上留下了一个明显的凹痕。

它当然也有一些缺点。虽然 OhSnap 宣称 Wallet 2“薄得不可思议”，但只有在最薄的 3 卡版本、且不装更厚更重的 MagSafe 和 MagStack 面板（后者可以让你在其上吸附其他磁性配件）时，它才真正显得出奇地纤薄。不过，我不买它的原因在于价格和重量。7 卡版本会让我的手机感觉太沉，增加 127 克重量；虽然我很乐意在几周时间里把 3 卡版本当作钱包使用，但如果想在 Kickstarter 上购买带双磁铁套件的版本，需要花费 61 美元，零售价则为 76 美元。OhSnap 对额外配件的收费也高于我的预期（身份证卡盖或钞票夹就要 35 美元！）。

[图片：https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/ohsnap-wallet-2-1-004.jpg?quality=90&strip=all]

[图片：https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/ohsnap-wallet-2-1-003.jpg?quality=90&strip=all]

这次 OhSnap 没能让我掏钱。不过，我倒是能想象把它当作礼物送人。

It’s been a while since we’ve seen a good discount on the Apple AirPods Pro 3, but like the latest iPad Mini and the M5 MacBook Airs , a great one is happening now for October Prime Day. You can snag a pair of the noise-canceling earbuds that include five ear tip sizes, live translation, and fantastic sound for $179 at Amazon (originally $249). I expect other retailers to offer a similar price in the coming days.

This is the first time the price has gone below $190 since Prime Day in June. Since then, Apple launched the AirPods 5 , and the most feature-complete version with a wireless charging case costs $149.99 . Those are great if you prefer earbuds that don’t form a seal in your ears, but for everyone else, the AirPods Pro 3 are a much better value at just $30 more right now.

The AirPods Pro 3 have a new design that improves their fit, superior noise cancellation, better bass, and fairly accurate heart rate sensors. Read our review .

Amazon’s October Prime Day has effectively chopped off Apple’s June price increases. Usually $1,299, the 13-inch MacBook Air with the M5 chip and 512GB of storage is on sale for $1,099 at Amazon . That’s a more palatable price for a machine that’s significantly faster than Apple’s $699 MacBook Neo .

The 15-inch version, also with 512GB of storage, is $1,299 at Amazon (was $1,499). In addition to the larger screen, it has two additional speakers, for a total of six, and two additional GPU cores for better overall graphical performance.

Apple MacBook Air (M5)

Apple’s 2026 MacBook Air has an M5 chip and starts with 512GB of storage that’s significantly faster than previous generations. It’s still as excellent as ever despite a higher base price. Read our review .

$1299 $1099 at Amazon (13-inch, 512GB)

$1499 $1299 at Amazon (15-inch, 512GB)

The latest update to Apple’s midrange laptop includes a noticeable improvement to the speed of both the processor and storage. Even without flashy new features compared to the last-gen model, it’s still one of our favorite laptops, thanks to its long battery life, bright screen, and excellent speakers.

Read our Apple MacBook Air (2026, M5) review .

aiStories.fullContent:
Apple’s iPad Mini is temporarily on sale for its old price. | Photo: David Pierce / The Verge

Apple bumped up prices on several of its devices in June, and we haven’t seen a good discount on the iPad Mini since. Just ahead of Amazon’s October Prime Big Deals Days, however, both Wi-Fi only and cellular-connected models are $100 off. The Wi-Fi version with 128GB of storage is currently $499, the 256GB model is $599, and the cellular model with 128GB of storage is $649.

This base configuration of this tablet often sold for around $400 throughout 2025, so we get it if $500 for a tablet from late 2024 is still too much. But it’s the best price since late June, and if there’s a new version coming out later this year, it might be significantly more expensive.

The seventh-gen iPad Mini comes with Apple’s A17 Pro chip and support for Apple Intelligence. It’s also compatible with the Apple Pencil Pro and offers faster Wi-Fi and USB-C speeds. Read our review .

$599 $499 at Amazon (128GB, Wi-Fi)

$699 $599 at Amazon (256GB, Wi-Fi)

$899 $799 at Amazon (512GB, Wi-Fi)

We reviewed this version of the iPad Mini when it launched in 2024, and while we appreciated the processor upgrade and Apple Intelligence features, it felt lacking in some of the quality-of-life improvements found in the larger iPads that launched around the same time.

Read our Apple iPad Mini (2024) review .

aiStories.title: 联邦法官称Flock构成“无差别大规模监控”
aiStories.originalTitle: Federal judge calls Flock ‘indiscriminate mass surveillance’
aiStories.snippet: A federal judge ruled that a sheriff’s deputy violated a woman’s Fourth Amendment rights when using Flock to search for her license plate without a warrant.
aiStories.fullContent:
A federal judge ruled this week that a Tulsa, Oklahoma sheriff’s deputy violated a woman’s Fourth Amendment rights when using Flock Safety to search for her license plate without a warrant.

As reported by 404 Media, this ruling does not create a binding precedent, but it is one of the first times that a federal judge has ruled that a Flock search is unconstitutional.

In this case, Judge Sara Hill said the deputy should have obtained a warrant before searching the Flock database for the woman’s license plate, as he had “no apparent reason” for the search “other than the fact that [the woman’s vehicle] had a California license plate.”

The deputy then used the woman’s travel history in Flock as part of the justification for searching her car, where he allegedly discovered 91 pounds of meth. But Judge Hill wrote that all evidence obtained after the Flock search “must be suppressed as the fruit of a poisonous tree.”

Judge Hill also took broader aim at warrantless searches of the Flock database, writing that tracking people’s location — even when they’re in public places — becomes “constitutionally problematic when law enforcement can indiscriminately and passively catalog your whereabouts over an extended period of time and then use that information for any purpose whenever convenient.”

“This is a type of indiscriminate mass surveillance,” Hill wrote. “It is not targeted on a single individual, as in [Carpenter v. United States, a Supreme Court case focused on how government agencies access location data from cell phones]. It is a tool that collects information about all vehicles that pass by any network-connected camera at all times, and it serves up the information to law enforcement on demand.”

Hill joins a growing chorus of Flock critics from across the political spectrum. Numerous local and state governments, including Florida and Texas, have said they will stop using the technology. And on Friday, Senator Bernie Sanders introduced the Block Flock Act, which would bar federal agencies from using automated license plate readers such as Flock.

Flock CEO Garrett Langley — who we’ll be interviewing on-stage at TechCrunch Disrupt — has called for a “compromise” between privacy and safety and offered an apology to women who have been stalked by law enforcement officers using the Flock system. And with all those cancellations, Flock has also reportedly offered voluntary employee buyouts as a way to shrink its workforce.

Anthony Ha is TechCrunch’s weekend editor. Previously, he worked as a tech reporter at Adweek, a senior editor at VentureBeat, a local government reporter at the Hollister Free Lance, and vice president of content at a VC firm. He lives in New York City.

本周，一名联邦法官裁定，俄克拉何马州塔尔萨县一名治安官办公室副警长在没有搜查令的情况下使用Flock Safety查找一名女性的车牌，侵犯了她受美国宪法第四修正案保护的权利。

据404 Media报道，这一裁决并不构成具有约束力的先例，但这是联邦法官首次认定Flock搜索违宪的案例之一。

在此案中，萨拉·希尔法官表示，这名副警长在搜索Flock数据库、查找该女性车牌之前本应取得搜查令，因为他进行搜索“没有明显理由”，“唯一原因似乎就是[该女性的车辆]挂着加利福尼亚州车牌”。

随后，这名副警长利用该女性在Flock系统中的出行记录，作为搜查其车辆的部分依据；据称，他在车内发现了91磅甲基苯丙胺。但希尔法官写道，在Flock搜索之后取得的所有证据“都必须作为毒树之果予以排除”。

希尔法官还将矛头扩大到对Flock数据库进行无搜查令搜索的问题。她写道，追踪人们的位置——即使他们身处公共场所——“当执法部门能够在较长时间内不加区别、被动地记录你的行踪，然后在任何方便的时候将这些信息用于任何目的时，就会产生宪法层面的疑问”。

希尔写道：“这是一种无差别的大规模监控。它并非针对某一个人，就像[‘卡彭特诉美国案’——一宗聚焦政府机构如何获取手机位置数据的最高法院案件]那样。这是一种持续收集所有经过任何联网摄像头的车辆信息的工具，并按执法部门的要求提供这些信息。”

希尔加入了来自不同政治立场、日益壮大的Flock批评者行列。包括佛罗里达州和得克萨斯州在内的众多地方及州政府已表示将停止使用这项技术。而在周五，参议员伯尼·桑德斯提出《阻止Flock法案》，该法案将禁止联邦机构使用Flock这类自动车牌识别系统。

Flock首席执行官加勒特·兰利——我们将在TechCrunch Disrupt大会现场对他进行采访——曾呼吁在隐私与安全之间达成“妥协”，并向那些遭到使用Flock系统的执法人员跟踪的女性致歉。随着这些取消使用的情况出现，Flock据报道还提出了自愿员工买断计划，以此缩减员工规模。

aiStories.title: 杰克·多尔西的 Bitchat 在印度政府下令后从应用商店消失
aiStories.originalTitle: Jack Dorsey’s Bitchat disappears from app stores in India after government order
aiStories.snippet: Bitchat has become largely unavailable in India as a result of the restrictions.
aiStories.fullContent:
Bitchat, Jack Dorsey’s decentralized messaging app designed to work without an internet connection, has disappeared from Apple and Google’s app stores in India, months after New Delhi first sought to restrict access to the open-source software.

Dorsey said Saturday that the Indian government had ordered Apple to remove Bitchat from its App Store in the country. In a notice from Apple that Dorsey posted on X, India’s Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology issued the demand under Section 69A of the Information Technology Act, the country’s primary legal provision for government-ordered online blocking.

Apple’s notice said Bitchat would remain available on its App Store outside India. However, access to the app through its TestFlight beta-testing service would also be blocked in the country.

Bitchat was also no longer available for download through Google Play in India when TechCrunch checked on Saturday. Bitchat’s website was also inaccessible across various internet service providers in the country. It was not immediately clear whether Google and internet service providers had also received directions from the federal government.

Apple, Google, and India’s IT ministry did not respond to requests for comment.

Launched in July last year, Bitchat uses Bluetooth mesh networking to allow nearby devices to exchange encrypted messages without relying on cellular networks, internet access, or centralized servers.

In July 2026, Dorsey revealed that Indian authorities had ordered GitHub to take down repositories associated with the open-source messaging app, raising questions among digital rights advocates and legal experts about the legal basis for restricting software based on its functionality.

The Indian government said in its order to GitHub at the time that Bitchat’s architecture made it hard for law enforcement agencies to intercept communications or trace users, and pointed to its ability to continue operating during internet shutdowns. The July order relied on a provision of India’s information technology law that deals with intermediaries and their liability for third-party content. That differs from Section 69A, cited in Apple’s latest notice.

The Internet Freedom Foundation, a New Delhi-based digital rights advocacy group, called the latest order unconstitutional, arguing that Section 69A allows the government to block unlawful information but not a messaging app because of its ability to operate during internet shutdowns. It also said neither the blocking order nor the allegedly illegal content cited as the basis for the action had been made public.

The latest restrictions on Bitchat come as India is seeing a fresh wave of ⁠youth-led protests over changes to the country’s voter rolls. Police detained several people during demonstrations in New Delhi on Saturday, as protesters demanded the resignation of India’s chief election commissioner over alleged manipulation of electoral rolls. Authorities suspended internet services around New Delhi’s Jantar Mantar for 12 hours on Friday during protests there.

During July’s protests, demonstrators reportedly turned to Bitchat and rival app Briar after authorities suspended internet services.

Interest in Bitchat surged in India around the same time. The country accounted for about 85% of the app’s global downloads between July 17 and July 23, up from roughly 1% in the previous 30 days, data from market intelligence firm Sensor Tower showed.

aiStories.fullTranslation:
Bitchat 是杰克·多尔西推出的一款去中心化消息应用，旨在无需互联网连接即可运行。继新德里数月前首次寻求限制这款开源软件的访问后，该应用已从印度的苹果和谷歌应用商店消失。

多尔西周六表示，印度政府已下令苹果将 Bitchat 从该国的 App Store 下架。在多尔西发布于 X 平台的一份苹果通知中，印度电子和信息技术部依据《信息技术法》第69A条提出了这一要求。该条款是印度政府下令封锁在线内容的主要法律依据。

苹果的通知称，Bitchat 仍将在印度以外地区的 App Store 上架。不过，在印度通过苹果的 TestFlight 测试服务访问该应用也将被封锁。

TechCrunch 周六核查发现，Bitchat 也已无法在印度通过 Google Play 下载。Bitchat 的网站在该国多家互联网服务提供商的网络上同样无法访问。目前尚不清楚谷歌和互联网服务提供商是否也收到了联邦政府的指令。

苹果、谷歌和印度信息技术部均未回应置评请求。

Bitchat 于去年7月推出，利用蓝牙网状网络，让附近设备能够交换加密消息，而不依赖蜂窝网络、互联网连接或集中式服务器。

2026年7月，多尔西透露，印度当局已下令 GitHub 删除与这款开源消息应用有关的代码仓库。这一行动引发了数字权利倡导者和法律专家的疑问：政府限制软件是否可以仅仅基于其功能特性。

印度政府当时在发给 GitHub 的命令中表示，Bitchat 的架构使执法机构难以拦截通信或追踪用户，并指出该应用能够在互联网关闭期间继续运行。7月的命令依据的是印度信息技术法中有关中介机构及其对第三方内容承担责任的条款。这与苹果最新通知中援引的第69A条有所不同。

总部位于新德里的数字权利倡导组织“互联网自由基金会”称，最新命令违宪。该组织认为，第69A条允许政府封锁非法信息，但不能因为一款消息应用能够在互联网关闭期间运行，就封锁该应用。该组织还表示，无论是封锁命令，还是据称构成采取行动依据的非法内容，均未被公开。

对 Bitchat 的最新限制出台之际，印度正因选民名册变更而迎来新一轮由年轻人主导的抗议活动。周六，警方在新德里示威期间拘留了数人。抗议者要求印度首席选举专员因涉嫌操纵选民名册而辞职。周五抗议活动期间，当局暂停了新德里金达尔·曼塔尔周边地区的互联网服务，时长达12小时。

据报道，在7月的抗议活动期间，当局暂停互联网服务后，示威者转而使用 Bitchat 及其竞争应用 Briar。

与此同时，印度对 Bitchat 的兴趣激增。市场情报公司 Sensor Tower 的数据显示，7月17日至23日期间，印度约占该应用全球下载量的85%；而在此前30天内，这一比例约为1%。

aiStories.title: Vessev打造了一艘几乎会飞的电动渡轮
aiStories.originalTitle: Vessev built an electric ferry that almost flies
aiStories.snippet: Vessev hopes its electric hydrofoil ferry will change the way people and cities think about boats.
aiStories.fullContent:
“When will we start flying?” I asked Vessev co-founder and CEO Eric Laakmann, as we pulled away from the Brooklyn marina in the startup’s VS-9 electric ferry. “We already are.”

I’ll admit I was a bit disappointed. I thought the moment when it transitioned from sailing like a regular boat to almost-flying as a surface-skimming hydrofoil would be more … momentous.

I’ve been on my share of boats, including large ferries, small sailboats, and plenty of others in between, but never been on a hydrofoil and I was curious what flying along the water might feel like during the brief ride from the Brooklyn Marina out toward Governors Island on the East River in New York.

It didn’t feel like flying, but it was a bit like a riding in a sports car.

Traditional boats of this size — about 30 feet — start to bounce and slap the water as they gain speed. But on a hydrofoil, that’s when the foils start to do their work.

On the surface, the VS-9 looks like plenty of other catamarans. But under the hull are two wing-like structures that lift the boat as they slice through the water. Computer-controlled underwater flaps keep the ride smooth and stable. In the VS-9, most of the lifting is done by the front foil, with about 20% handled by the rear.

The rear foil also hosts the electric motor, which Vessev makes in-house. Why not outsource it? Laakmann said that it’s important to keep costs in line — eventually, you’ll have to bring production in house, so why not do it earlier in development? The only thing Vessev doesn’t build are the batteries. “Those have been commoditized,” Laakmann said.

By lifting the hull clear of the water, hydrofoils can operate more efficiently than other boats. That’s especially important for electric boats, where every kilowatt-hour counts.

Shipbuilders have been experimenting with hydrofoils for well over a century. The design offers several advantages, including lower drag and a smoother ride. The subtle transition I experienced on the VS-9, from sailing to almost-flying, underlined just how smooth a hydrofoil can be.

Despite hydrofoils’ advantages, they’re not a panacea. The design works best in waters the boat can clear when sailing on its foils. For the VS-9, that’s about two and a half feet, or 0.75 meters. If the waves go higher than that, they start hitting the hull, ruining the smooth ride and sapping some efficiency. While they’re not ideal for the open ocean, hydrofoils make sense for other waterways, including lakes, rivers, and bays.

Vessev, which raised a $19 million Series A in August, is targeting transit operations to start. Laakmann thinks the combination of electric propulsion and hydrofoils can bring down the cost of operating smaller vessels and make them comfortable enough that they could augment urban mass transit systems.

Somewhere like New York City could use them to zip people to Brooklyn or Queens without needing to build much new infrastructure.

Hotels and tour operators are also an early target market, and public demonstrations like the one I attended have attracted wealthy individuals looking for another toy, Laakmann said.

For now, the VS-9 I rode is one of a kind, but Laakmann said Vessev plans to build more. Eventually, the company might shift to producing electric hydrofoil kits, allowing other boatbuilders to design their own vessels around the technology, Laakmann said.

“我们什么时候开始飞？”当我们乘坐这家初创公司的VS-9电动渡轮驶离布鲁克林码头时，我问Vessev联合创始人兼首席执行官埃里克·拉克曼。“我们已经在飞了。”

我得承认，我有点失望。我原以为，它从像普通船只一样航行，转变为借助水翼在水面掠过、几乎飞起来的那一刻，会更加……具有划时代意义。

我坐过不少船，包括大型渡轮、小型帆船以及介于两者之间的许多其他船只，但从未乘坐过水翼船。因此，在纽约东河上从布鲁克林码头驶向总督岛的这段短途旅程中，我很好奇贴着水面飞驰会是什么感觉。

它感觉不像飞行，但有点像乘坐一辆跑车。

这种尺寸的传统船只——大约30英尺（约9米）——在加速时会开始上下颠簸并拍打水面。但对于水翼船来说，正是在这个时候，水翼开始发挥作用。

从水面上看，VS-9与许多其他双体船并无二致。但船体下方有两个形似机翼的结构，它们切开水面时会将船体抬升起来。由计算机控制的水下襟翼则让航行保持平稳和稳定。在VS-9上，大部分升力由前水翼提供，后水翼承担约20%。

后水翼还搭载着电动机，该电动机由Vessev自行制造。为什么不把它外包出去？拉克曼说，控制成本非常重要——最终你不得不把生产转回内部，那么为什么不在研发早期就这么做呢？Vessev唯一不生产的是电池。“电池已经商品化了。”拉克曼说。

水翼将船体抬离水面后，船只的运行效率可以高于其他船型。这对于电动船尤其重要，因为每一千瓦时的电量都至关重要。

一个多世纪以来，造船商一直在试验水翼船。这种设计具有多项优势，包括更低的阻力和更平稳的乘坐体验。我在VS-9上体验到的、从航行到几乎飞行的微妙转换，凸显了水翼船能够多么平稳。

尽管水翼具有诸多优势，但它们并不是万能药。这种设计最适合船只在水翼航行时能够避开的水域。对于VS-9来说，这一高度约为2.5英尺，即0.75米。如果波浪超过这一高度，就会开始撞击船体，破坏平稳的航行体验，并损失一部分效率。水翼船并不适合开阔海域，但在湖泊、河流和海湾等其他水域具有合理性。

Vessev在8月完成了1900万美元的A轮融资，目前首先瞄准的是公共交通运营。拉克曼认为，电力推进与水翼技术相结合，可以降低小型船只的运营成本，并让乘坐足够舒适，从而使这类船只能够补充城市公共交通系统。

例如在纽约市，人们可以利用这种船只快速前往布鲁克林或皇后区，而无需建设大量新的基础设施。

拉克曼说，酒店和旅游运营商也是早期目标市场；而我参加的这类公开展示活动，也吸引了一些希望再添置一件玩具的富裕人士。

目前，我乘坐的这艘VS-9独一无二，但拉克曼表示，Vessev计划建造更多同型船只。他说，最终公司可能会转向生产电动水翼套件，让其他造船商围绕这项技术设计自己的船只。

aiStories.title: Spotify亿万富翁创办的身体扫描初创公司进军美国
aiStories.originalTitle: Spotify billionaire’s body scan startup has come to America
aiStories.snippet: Farooq Abbasi, an investor in Neko Health, talked to Equity about the hot health tech company and what's next for it.
aiStories.fullContent:
Neko Health seems to be the hottest body scan in the world right now.

The scan, co-founded by Spotify’s David Ek and Hjalmar Nilsonne, uses advanced technology to screen for issues in the blood, skin, and metabolism. The company was founded in Sweden, has raised nearly $1 billion total, and just landed in New York. It has a global waitlist already topping 300,000 people, the company says.

TechCrunch sat down with Farooq Abbasi of Preface Ventures, who invested in the company. He hopes Neko Health can be the future of preventative medicine, especially in a country like the United States, where the medical system is notoriously plagued with issues.

Abbasi contends that preventative care utilization is low in the U.S. as people have concerns about how much it costs. Currently, Neko health charges $500 for its one-hour scan, which is not covered by insurance but should qualify as an acceptable expense for those that have Health Savings Accounts. “I think preventative care and healthcare should be cheap and accessible,” Abbasi said.

The hope is that Neko Health can tackle some of these issues, and it’s currently eyeing an expansion across the U.S. Abbasi has been scanned twice already and, perhaps, no surprise, says he loves it. “I think there should be Neko clinics everywhere,” he said.

He says the product has grown so much since he first tried it. “In my generation one scan, it was a blood test with 15 biomarkers,” he said. “It was fifty-five this time.”

Neko also uses advanced computer vision for its scans and Abbasi sees this as another example of how AI is improving the medical sector overall. He argues that Neko Health isn’t just another wellness fad, but something that gives people “actionable insights to make their lives better,” he said.

Neko still has a long way to go in the U.S., especially on scaling and regulatory approval. But Abbasi is an optimist; he hopes more venture dollars will pour into the right companies and doesn’t think anything is too broken to fix.

aiStories.fullTranslation:
Neko Health似乎是目前全球最热门的身体扫描服务。

这项扫描服务由Spotify联合创始人之一大卫·埃克（David Ek）和哈尔马尔·尼尔松内（Hjalmar Nilsonne）共同创办，利用先进技术筛查血液、皮肤和代谢方面的问题。该公司成立于瑞典，目前累计融资近10亿美元，最近刚刚落地纽约。据该公司称，其全球候诊名单目前已超过30万人。

TechCrunch采访了Preface Ventures的法鲁克·阿巴西（Farooq Abbasi），该公司曾投资Neko Health。阿巴西希望Neko Health能够成为预防医学的未来，尤其是在美国这样一个医疗体系长期饱受问题困扰的国家。

阿巴西认为，美国的预防性医疗利用率较低，原因之一是人们担心费用过高。目前，Neko Health的一次一小时扫描收费500美元，保险不予报销，但对于拥有健康储蓄账户（HSA）的人来说，这笔费用应当符合可接受的支出标准。阿巴西说：“我认为预防性医疗和医疗保健都应该价格低廉、人人可及。”

Neko Health希望能够解决其中一些问题，目前正在考虑向美国各地扩张。阿巴西已经接受过两次扫描，而且或许并不令人意外的是，他表示自己很喜欢这项服务。他说：“我认为各地都应该有Neko诊所。”

他说，自他第一次体验这项服务以来，产品已经取得了很大发展。他说：“我第一次接受的扫描中，血液检测包含15项生物标志物。这一次是55项。”

Neko还在扫描过程中使用先进的计算机视觉技术。阿巴西认为，这也是人工智能整体改善医疗行业的又一例证。他表示，Neko Health并不只是又一种健康潮流，而是能够为人们提供“可据此采取行动的洞见，帮助他们改善生活”的服务。

Neko在美国仍有很长的路要走，尤其是在扩大规模和获得监管批准方面。不过，阿巴西是一名乐观主义者；他希望更多风险投资资金能够流向真正合适的公司，也不认为有什么问题是彻底无法修复的。

trendStories.fullContent:
Readers respond to an article on the urgent need for palliative care reform

Jane Turner is right that end-of‑life care needs fixing ( MPs, you told us clearly that end-of-life care in the UK is broken. So now we need you to fix it, 28 September ), and I argue that it needs fixing on two fronts at once. My husband, John, died in March aged 43 after nearly six years of bowel cancer treatment. He endured more than 70 rounds of chemotherapy, determined to watch our children grow up. He spent his last three months in a hospice, receiving the best palliative care on offer. Even so, he suffered terribly.

Some pain cannot be controlled quickly, and some suffering cannot be treated at all. One evening he screamed in agony while stranded in a bath, unable to move, for nearly an hour before relief took effect. As the cancer swelled his torso, he slowly suffocated – and no drug could prevent it. He was fully aware throughout, and told me repeatedly that he could not go on. In his last hours, I wore earplugs to bear the sound of his gasping.
trendStories.fullTranslation:
读者回应一篇关于迫切需要改革姑息治疗的文章

简·特纳说得对，临终关怀需要得到改善（议员们，你们已经清楚地告诉我们，英国的临终关怀体系已经陷入失灵。因此，现在需要你们着手修复，9月28日），而我认为，这一问题需要从两个方面同时着手解决。我丈夫约翰今年3月去世，享年43岁，此前他接受了近六年的肠癌治疗。他先后进行了70多轮化疗，一心想要看着我们的孩子长大。在生命最后三个月里，他住进了临终关怀医院，接受当时所能提供的最佳姑息治疗。即便如此，他仍遭受了极大的痛苦。

有些疼痛无法迅速得到控制，有些痛苦则根本无法医治。一天晚上，他被困在浴缸里，无法动弹，在剧痛中尖叫了将近一个小时，之后缓解疼痛的药物才开始起效。随着癌症使他的躯干逐渐肿胀，他慢慢窒息——没有任何药物能够阻止这一过程。他始终完全清醒，并反复告诉我，他已经无法继续忍受下去了。在生命最后几个小时里，我戴上耳塞，才能忍受他喘息的声音。

trendStories.fullContent:
The idea of universal health coverage in the US is embraced by party’s left but is often considered a liability by centrists

Last week, 1,500 unionized nurses gathered in a large conference room at the Marriott Marquis in San Francisco to cheer for a cause they’ve championed for years: Medicare for All.

Considered a radical and even fringe idea for decades, interest in sweeping healthcare reform has surged as progressive Democrats have won a series of primary victories ahead of November’s crucial midterm elections. Most prominent among its advocates is Democratic US Senate nominee from Michigan Abdul El-Sayed – who took the lectern before these nurses.
trendStories.fullTranslation:
这一关于在美国实现全民医保的主张受到民主党左翼拥护，但中间派往往认为它会成为一种负担。

上周，1500名加入工会的护士聚集在旧金山万豪侯爵酒店的一间大型会议室里，为他们多年来一直倡导的事业——“全民医保”——欢呼。

几十年来，全面改革医疗保健一直被视为激进、甚至边缘化的主张。然而，随着进步派民主党人在11月关键的中期选举前接连赢得初选胜利，人们对大规模医疗改革的兴趣迅速升温。其最 prominent 的倡导者之一，是密歇根州民主党籍美国参议院候选人阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德——他在这些护士面前走上讲台。

trendStories.fullContent:
Maybe the key to life is being able to bench press 300lb at 75. But do we need more muscle-bound, angry guys around?

I loathe going to the doctor.

Not a controversial opinion, compared to some of the other ones in this section of the Guardian. I’m not exactly arguing for universal basic income or for Manchester City to be relegated to the Saudi Pro League here. No one looks forward to a doctor visit, with its recriminations for bad habits or various intrusive blood tests. People don’t have cocktail parties to celebrate their yearly check-up, and yet, it seems like every day, there’s a new reason to go get prodded by a stranger in a lab coat.
trendStories.fullTranslation:
也许，人生的关键在于75岁时还能卧推300磅。但我们真的需要身边有更多肌肉发达、怒气冲冲的男人吗？

我讨厌去看医生。

与《卫报》这一版块中的其他一些观点相比，这算不上什么有争议的看法。我可不是在主张全民基本收入，也不是在主张把曼彻斯特城降级到沙特职业联赛——至少在这里不是。没有人会期待去看医生，因为那意味着要面对别人对不良习惯的责备，或接受各种令人不适的验血。然而，人们不会举办鸡尾酒会来庆祝年度体检，可看起来，我们每天都会有一个新的理由，去让一个穿白大褂的陌生人戳来戳去。
